title: WB-F1 round surprise report (07b)
description: rounds/RNN/surprise.json (engine/steps/surprise.ts SurpriseFile), absent when 07b skipped (unseal invalid or measures.surprise inactive). submissions maps a submission id to its SurpriseReport (engine/tasks/surprise.ts): status full|reused|match_only|insufficient; counts surprising, eligible (details minus unresolved), drift, unresolved, forecast; details[] {id, image, quote, families, outcome forecast|surprising|drift|unresolved, forecasts (opaque ids P01…, never values), writer_default, chain, accept_reason}; chains[] {detail, canon {file, quote} | null, steps (0–2), lands_on}; acceptor_reused; roles {matchers, chain_writer, acceptor}; tasks (task ids). No threshold; sealed forecast values never appear here.
